ttm_method: FY2025 + H1 2026 - H1 2025. OCF-PPE is a diagnostic only, not normalized owner FCF.
scenario_method: Equity-cash style revenue x owner-cash-margin model. Owner margins are after ordinary operating interest burden; no separate net-debt subtraction is stacked on the same cash stream. Mobility economics are retained on a consolidated-equivalent basis for comparability, and neither the expected $1.1B Eaton cash distribution nor future Dana/Mobility shares are separately added, avoiding double counting.

reverse_expectations.method: Hold Base year-1 revenue, owner-margin path, 19x terminal multiple and 9% required return; solve one constant revenue growth rate for years 2-10.

model_limits: The planned Mobility Reverse Morris Trust is not a simple cash sale; Eaton shareholders are expected to own at least 50.1% of the combined company and Eaton expects an approximately $1.1B cash distribution. The reference model therefore avoids separately capitalizing those items.
Boyd Thermal and Ultra PCS are only partially represented in TTM reported cash flows, while acquisition debt and interest are also newly ramping.
Backlog is evidence of demand visibility, not guaranteed long-duration revenue or margin.
Terminal multiples and owner margins are estimates, not facts.
